importantFindings: Back Cove 29 heritage page contains a likely imperial typo: 9 ft 5 in conflicts with its own 3.20 m value and original 10 ft 5 in brochure. Canonical beam is 10 ft 5 in.
Back Cove 33 was explicitly relaunched as the Back Cove 34 in 2012; records remain searchable but lineage is linked.
Back Cove 32 canonical LOA corrected to 37 ft overall rather than the legacy 32.5 ft hull-number-based approximation.
Sabre 38 Salon Express uses production phases because the original pod-drive generation was reintroduced in 2026 with Volvo Penta DPI sterndrives.
Duffy records are hull-family/semi-custom records, so layouts, machinery and tankage must remain hull-specific where documentation varies.
Duffy 35 production history corrected toward the 1981 design / 1982 build lineage; Duffy 42 is documented through 2006.
Fortier 33 supports both conventional twin inboards and optional IPS, so propulsion is not forced model-wide.
Hunt Surfhunter 29 supports sterndrive, V-drive, waterjet and outboard configurations; propulsion remains configuration-specific.
Hunt Surfhunter 36 Coupe dimensions are validated and its pod/shaft propulsion variability is preserved.
